$comment: R350 S4 + r353-F — the committed golden-set baseline. Re-pinned 2026-11-15 in the SAME commit that expanded the corpus with the realistic registrar shapes (student numbers, phones, emails, 1-edit typos, multiword order, both fold directions, plain-keyboard forms) and rebuilt the engine's fetch stage (reverse-fold + ال/per-word variants) and rank arms (multiword/typo/identifier tiers). Old baseline (352 queries, r1=0.9119, r5=0.9830, r10=0.9915, MRR=0.9467) measured the rank stage only, on a corpus with zero identifier/phone/typo shapes. Measured on the pre-r353-F engine, the NEW set scores r1=0.548, r5=0.587, MRR=0.567, fetch-recall=0.559 — the honest before/after witness. Re-pin ONLY with a documented improvement or an authorised give-back (the ratchet law): edit the numbers to the freshly measured values in the same commit that changes the corpus or the engine.
